title: Combat, buffs & recovery
summary: Casting, lasting buffs and getting back into the world.
body:
Lasting blessings and temporary abilities

Ordinary beneficial blessings on you and your owned pets persist without timer upkeep. Temporary AA effects, including Killing Spree and related triggered buffs, disciplines and short-duration song-window effects retain their timers. Death, dispels, replacement, stacking rules, charges and aura range still matter. Debuffs and hostile NPC buffs keep their timers.

Bard songs and effect duration

Song-window effects keep their normal timers; do not assume every beneficial song is permanent. Harmful effects such as damage, charm and mez keep their normal rules. Movement-song behavior is still being checked.

Blessing effects that survive reconnects

Repairs restore saved buff effects after login and stop permanent blessings expiring on the next tick. You should not need another hail or payment; player retesting continues.

Instant damage-over-time casts

Your damage-over-time spells cast instantly, while keeping mana costs, target and resistance checks, and reuse limits. Direct-damage spells keep their normal cast times.

Melee attacks during casting

Main-hand and offhand autoattacks can continue while you cast. Range, stuns, fear, and other control effects still apply.

Keep your belongings after death

Return to your bind point with equipment, inventory, and money. You still lose beneficial buffs; other death rules are unchanged.

Throw Stone and Spell Damage

Throw Stone now adds effective Spell Damage directly. At 250 Spell Damage, it deals 251 ordinary damage before other modifiers. Encounter balance remains under testing.

Spell gems after death

Memorized spell gems now persist through normal death. Death and reconnect testing is still ongoing.

Heal yourself while keeping an enemy targeted

Ordinary heals cast with an NPC or pet selected heal you while keeping that target selected. Select another player to heal them. Pet-only and other specialized spells retain their target rules.

Food and drink are optional

Hunger and thirst no longer penalize recovery, and ordinary food/drink consumption no longer removes those items. Optional food bonuses, crafting ingredients and alcohol keep their own uses. Sell All preserves food, drink and spell supplies.
